draft.emotion: wide-eyed and shrinking back slightly, feeling genuine trepidation
notes: ㅂ-irregular adjective: drops 'ㅂ' and adds '우' before a vowel (무서워요, 무서운).
Covers both 'scary' and 'scared': the thing causing fear takes 이/가 (개가 무서워요 = I am afraid of dogs / Dogs are scary).
Unlike '두렵다', which is more formal and refers to deep dread, '무섭다' is the everyday word for fear.
